findingsAndLimits.manualProcedure: Stationary only says partial_t(v)=0; if parabolic profile with vmax8, v(R/2)=8(1-1/4)=6cm/s. Need supplied parabolic fully-developed circular profile for6; stationary alone does not determine6. Once profile given,8*3/4 by manual multiplication.
